# SMAC Digital — Performance-Driven Digital Marketing Agency

> SMAC Digital is a premier full-service digital marketing agency in India delivering high-ROI Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Social Media Marketing (SMM), Lead Generation, Performance Marketing, Inbound Marketing, Digital Media Planning, and Web & Mobile App Development.

## Brand & Company Overview
SMAC Digital stands for Social, Mobile, Analytics, and Cloud (SMAC). We partner with high-growth businesses and D2C brands across Jaipur, Delhi, Pune, Kolkata, and worldwide to accelerate organic rankings, scale paid media ROI, and engineer robust digital experiences.

## Core Marketing & Tech Services
- [search-engine-optimization](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/search-engine-optimization): Search Engine Optimization (SEO) — Technical audits, on-page optimization, quality link acquisition, and keyword ranking growth.
- [social-media-marketing](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/social-media-marketing): Social Media Marketing (SMM) — Paid social campaigns, community management, brand storytelling, and viral engagement.
- [lead-generation](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/lead-generation): B2B & B2C Lead Generation — High-converting landing pages, paid funnels, and verified SQL/MQL pipeline generation.
- [inbound-marketing](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/inbound-marketing): Inbound Marketing — Content hubs, lead magnets, automated email nurturing, and customer lifecycle retention.
- [digital-media-planning](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/digital-media-planning): Digital Media Planning — Strategic budget allocation, audience intelligence, and multi-channel programmatic media buys.
- [website-design-and-development](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/website-design-and-development): Website Design & Development — High-performance responsive websites, UI/UX design, and fast modern web apps.
- [mobile-application-development](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/mobile-application-development): Mobile Application Development — Native and cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications.
- [content-marketing](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/content-marketing): Content Marketing — Thought leadership articles, editorial strategy, and authoritative industry research.
- [online-reputation-management](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/online-reputation-management): Online Reputation Management (ORM) — Review monitoring, crisis mitigation, and positive brand sentiment protection.
- [marketing-automation](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/marketing-automation): Marketing Automation — CRM workflow orchestration, WhatsApp API integrations, and behavioral trigger funnels.
- [influencer-marketing](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/influencer-marketing): Influencer Marketing — Creator partnerships, sponsored influencer campaigns, and performance tracking.
- [video-marketing](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/video-marketing): Video Marketing — High-impact short-form videos, YouTube optimization, and visual brand commercials.
- [devops-services](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/devops-services): DevOps Services — Cloud infrastructure scalability, CI/CD pipeline automation, and server monitoring.
- [sentiment-analysis](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/sentiment-analysis): Sentiment Analysis — NLP consumer opinion mining and social listening intelligence.
- [social-media-analytics](https://www.smacdigital.com/services/social-media-analytics): Social Media Analytics — Multi-platform dashboard reporting, competitor benchmarking, and attribution.
